headline: Cyclone Xavier batters the northern Cook Islands
summary: Severe Tropical Cyclone Xavier reached Category 5, the highest level, over the northern Cook Islands this week, with gusts of up to 315 km/h near its centre, local forecasters said. By 19 November local time it had weakened to Category 4, 1News reports.
why: The northern Cook Islands are low-lying atolls, exposed to strong winds, high seas and coastal flooding.

event.t: The Cook Islands Meteorological Service warned of damaging winds, heavy rain, dangerous seas and coastal flooding, especially for Pukapuka and Nassau.
Residents were urged to stay in safe shelter and away from the coast.
1News reports the storm was moving slowly between Manihiki and Pukapuka; a Manihiki resident said people there were prepared and safe.

effects.label: Northern Cook Islands
effects.t: Gales, heavy rain and a risk of coastal flooding.

watch: Damage reports once the storm passes

cin.t: Severe Cyclone Xavier threatens Pukapuka, Nassau and Suwarrow
